Continue this exact moonlit rainy mounted fight from the supplied first frame, preserving the identical filmic anime style and character proportions. The SAME canonical hero has a full angular black-and-silver mask, dark lamellar chest armor, silver flame pauldrons, and red ribbon. The same black horse keeps its WHITE forehead blaze and WHITE nose markings. Hero is ALWAYS seated in the saddle, left hand on reins, right hand holds ONE sword. ONE gray-armored foot guard has one round shield and one short sword. Guard remains beside the hoof lane.
0-2 seconds: the gray guard uses his right-hand short sword for a quick counterstrike; mounted hero lifts his blade into a VISIBLE brief steel-on-steel parry ABOVE the horse's shoulder, a tiny spark lasts 0.1 second, blades push and recoil immediately. 2-4.5 seconds: hero makes a quick diagonal return cut contacting the upper outer edge of the guard's round shield. Shield clearly rotates under impact, guard's elbow flexes; contact is brief then the sword releases. 4.5-7 seconds: horse keeps balanced short forward canter steps with weight shifting naturally through articulated legs and a small controlled arc. Guard retreats two steps while guarding. Hero performs ONE compact backhand slash contacting the opposite lower shield rim, a short silver ink trail follows ONLY the blade. Guard drops his weight and stumbles aside in reaction. 7-10 seconds: complete clean separation, then horse accelerates to screen RIGHT past the guard, keeping mounted hero and WHOLE horse visible. Guard remains visible far behind to the left. Hero's final travel direction is RIGHT, continuing into the next shot.
Crisp fast animated attacks at normal real-time speed, fluid continuous movement between each strike, no long locked parry, no freeze, no held animation cel and no slow motion. Camera gently tracks from side or three-quarter side, NO ORBIT, no frontal camera cut, no instant zoom; rider travels screen left to right. All three impacts are readable and physically touch then recoil; never pass through body or shield. Keep weapon contact unobscured, tiny momentary sparks only. Keep same concealed anime face, armor and horse identity. Rider never dismounts. Guard never disappears. No extra heroes, extra weapons, collision with the horse, or jumping over the soldier. No text, logos, speech or audio.
